description: Software Factory enforcement for the GitHub Copilot CLI: agents propose, the CLI and these hooks decide. Native Copilot format (camelCase events, flat outputs); no matchers — each script filters by the normalised tool name. If node is missing the hooks exit 0 with a warning on stderr (a non-zero preToolUse exit would deny every tool).

sessionStart.bash: R="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}}"; [ -f "$R/hooks/session-start.js" ] || { echo "[factory] hook script $R/hooks/session-start.js not found; hook skipped" >&2; exit 0; }; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "[factory] node is not on PATH; factory hooks are off (the guard allows everything)" >&2; exit 0; }; exec node "$R/hooks/session-start.js" sessionStart
sessionStart.powershell: $r = if ($env:PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:PLUGIN_ROOT } elseif ($env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT } else { $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT }; if (-not (Test-Path "$r/hooks/session-start.js")) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("[factory] hook script $r/hooks/session-start.js not found; hook skipped"); exit 0 }; if (-not (Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("[factory] node is not on PATH; factory hooks are off (the guard allows everything)"); exit 0 }; node "$r/hooks/session-start.js" sessionStart; exit $LASTEXITCODE
